desc: The week's raid boss alone, played in full (TTYD_RAID_TEST with TTYD_RAID_SOLO; the late loadout lent; the auto-battler with god mode, no god power: it would multiply past the raid's phase lines; duo moves off, so the shell of phase 2 wears through in ten hits): all four phases, the fury of phase 3 staggered (TTYD_MODERUN_RAID_GUARD=1: the auto-battler's guards count as the Superguards it needs, which it never makes), the boss beaten, Raid Party earned, the loadout given back, Mario back where he started; control back with nothing lent and the file's stats, partners, badges, items, key items, Star Points and story as before (coins: the raid's 50 added after the pouch went back). The raid isn't one of Leave's modes, so its moderun lines come from moderun_battles_aurora.c as "Raid boss"
log_must: \[moderun\] check after Raid boss: stats same, partners same, badges same, items same, key items same, coins \d+ -> \d+, star points (\d+) -> \1, story same
